If SEHA is opened via https, the printer must be addressed via https too (accept its certificate once in the browser at https://IP), otherwise the browser blocks the request (mixed content).
help.StarWebPrnt: The browser sends the receipt directly to http(s)://IP/StarWebPRNT/SendMessage. WebPRNT must be enabled on the printer. If SEHA is opened via https, the printer must be reachable via https too (accept its certificate once in the browser), otherwise the browser blocks the request.

help.WebUsb: Chrome and Edge only. Pair the printer once on every till PC. On Windows the installed printer driver usually holds the device – then use WebSerial with a virtual COM port or the print dialog.
help.WebSerial: Chrome and Edge only. For serial printers and USB printers with a virtual COM port driver. Pair the port once on every till PC.
